reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected shape for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so no unnecessary edit was introduced.

The cited text supports compliance: p0995 (limits on MSL's use of IBM property and MSL's Integration for competing customers) and p0319 (Prohibited Suppliers list binding MSL) restrict the Vendor, not the Customer, which the rule expressly permits; p1490-1491 affirmatively preserves each Recipient's right to offer competing products and serve the Discloser's competitors, which benefits IBM as Customer.

No non-compete, field-of-use, territory or exclusivity covenant binding IBM appears in the cited material, so the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) is met and the deterministic check ('no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains') is consistent.

The p0189 employee non-solicit binding IBM is correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged: it is a personnel non-solicit with inbound-applicant and general-advertising carve-outs, not a restriction on businesses operated or products bought/built, and belongs to a non-solicitation rule — consistent with the no-double-flagging and minor-sub-element guidance.

Rationale tone and content are accurate and appropriately scoped; references to §§ 3.0/11.0 as scope-of-work only (no requirements/sole-source obligation on IBM) do not contradict any cited paragraph.
